supersedes: CODER2_UI_STATE_MAP.json (amended in place; the amended file remains the working map — this deliverable is the R458 §24 closure snapshot with the directive's required 14-state coverage plus the conversational additions)
authority: Every canonical user-visible state maps to EXACTLY ONE honest human representation. The frontend is a projection of canonical state (Art. X); it never re-derives, upgrades, or softens state (Art. XXVIII), never converts unknown into certainty (Art. XXV), and never converts infrastructure into a scientific verdict (Art. LXI).
canonical_sources: toscanini/dossier.py (evidence ledger, design tab + geometry_state, experiment tab, transfer tab)
SessionDetail.status (the terminal/transport authority — R451-C2-CLOSURE Direction C)

PENDING.canonical: run active; retrieval started, not landed
PENDING.human: Evidence retrieval is in progress — I'm searching the indexed sources now.
forbidden: any phrasing that implies absence or completion

NOT_REACHED.canonical: the run stopped before retrieval began
NOT_REACHED.human: The evidence stage was not reached on this run — retrieval never began. That is not a finding about the problem.

RETRIEVED_ZERO.canonical: retrieval executed and measured zero records
RETRIEVED_ZERO.human: The searches completed and returned no matching records. That is a statement about these queries in these databases — it is not evidence that the concept is novel or that no relevant work exists.

RETRIEVED_POSITIVE.human: I found N relevant sources in the evidence base. Each one is custody-frozen with a content hash.

FAILED.canonical: retrieval infrastructure failure (server-declared, or stage status FAIL)
FAILED.human: Evidence retrieval failed — the sources could not be reached. This is an infrastructure state, not evidence of absence. Nothing was concluded from it, and the run can resume where it stopped.
forbidden: rendering as a scientific conclusion of any kind

BLOCKED.canonical: RUN_BLOCKED_* terminal status (transport/capability) — THE singular authority; user_state_view cannot override it
BLOCKED.human: Current run blocked — I stopped partway; the infrastructure I need became unavailable. Nothing was concluded about your problem. Resume the investigation.
BLOCKED.rule: suppressStalePositives: every stale positive artifact on the record (older COMPLETED candidate, visual_complete, engineering=true) stays in the technical view and is NEVER read as a present-tense result
forbidden: the stale positive as current achievement

UNKNOWN.canonical: terminal with no recorded outcome (COMPLETED_UNKNOWN) or geometry_state NOT_ESTABLISHED
UNKNOWN.human: Outcome unknown / Engineering geometry is not established on this run. Nothing is rendered because nothing was established.
forbidden: translating unknown into unavailable (they are different facts)

NOT_RUN.canonical: attack_state empty / never reached on a terminal run
NOT_RUN.human: The adversarial test has not been completed. Nothing is claimed either way — a candidate is never called 'survived' by default.

REJECTED.canonical: COMPLETED_FALSE_PREMISE / outcome FALSE_PREMISE_INCOHERENT — the ONE bare scientific rejection (R451-C2 SCIENTIFIC_REJECTION vocabulary)
REJECTED.human: Rejected — the evidence contradicted the problem's premise. Rejected is a finding — the investigation did its job.
forbidden: hiding the rejection behind the next action
REJECTED.r458_rule: the verdict is read from the canonical user_state KEY only — the raw `rejected` boolean on the projection is a stale field (R452-B1 corrected it at the key layer) and is retired from the presentation decision path (measured live: run ts_da602dc2c698 rendered 'Rejected' where the canonical layer says killed-by-challenge/in-development; fixed and pinned by battery test B6b)

KILLED_BY_CHALLENGE.canonical: user_state COMPLETED_UNDER_DEVELOPMENT + outcome INVENTION_KILLED_BY_CHALLENGE (run_state.OUTCOME_KILLED_BY_CHALLENGE — the machine's own adversarial challenge killed the invention and no verified survivor replaced it)
KILLED_BY_CHALLENGE.human: Completed — invention in development: the machine's own adversarial challenge killed this invention and no verified survivor replaced it — the generation records show exactly what was killed and why. Next step: Reformulate the problem and run again.
forbidden: a bare 'Rejected' (two words for one canonical state violates §24)
presenting the killed candidate as current achievement
a dead end with no forward action

CONTESTED.canonical: attack escalated_objection (instrument not calibrated to decide)
CONTESTED.human: The adversarial instrument raised an objection it is not calibrated to decide, so the objection is preserved and escalated for adjudication — it is not treated as a verdict, and not treated as a pass either.

SURVIVED.canonical: attack_state SURVIVED/PASS/COMPLETE_PASS or generation challenge survived
SURVIVED.human: I tried to prove the leading candidate wrong — it survived the specified adversarial tests, including: "<strongest objection>".
SURVIVED.rule: survived is always stated WITH the tests it survived; it never implies physical validation (Art. XXVIII)

ENGINEERING.canonical: design availability AVAILABLE + engineering_authority ENGINEERING + geometry_state visual_complete (for VISUAL_READY)
ENGINEERING.human: The technology model is the run's canonical engineering geometry — the same geometry the record carries, not an illustration.

EXPERIMENT_READY.canonical: experiment tab availability AVAILABLE (Art. LII falsification contract present)
EXPERIMENT_READY.human: The decisive test is specified — the experiment that could kill the candidate, with its acceptance and falsification thresholds.

PACKAGE_READY.human: The technology package is assembled and ready — everything needed to evaluate, build, or commission the decisive experiment.
PACKAGE_READY.single_action: Download the technology package (the ONE package action; never a package wizard)

AWAITING_CLARIFICATION.canonical: status AWAITING_CLARIFICATION + clarification{question, decision_changed} (C1 R446 §4; consumed by the UI from R458-C2)
AWAITING_CLARIFICATION.human: Toscanini's one material question, verbatim, plus: Your answer decides: <decision_changed>. The investigation is paused — it will resume the moment you answer.
forbidden: rendering as an error or stall

PROVIDER_ROTATION.canonical: event record: infrastructure failure followed by later recorded progress (the R456 cascade precedent)
PROVIDER_ROTATION.human: I continued the investigation using another available reasoning route.
PROVIDER_ROTATION.rule: THE FRONTEND NEVER NAMES PROVIDERS OR MODELS. The route identity (provider A → failure class → provider B → model → latency → provenance) lives in the run's routing ledger in the TECHNICAL RECORD only (§26; BS-009).
forbidden: rendering the failure as a verdict

GEOMETRY_UNAVAILABLE_vs_UNKNOWN.canonical: UNAVAILABLE = established but presentation path down; UNKNOWN = nothing established; UNEARNED = architecture exists but no faithful visual could be produced

human_map.UNAVAILABLE: Engineering geometry exists on this run; the visual rendering is unavailable right now — an infrastructure state, and the geometry itself is unaffected.
human_map.UNKNOWN: Engineering geometry is not established on this run. Nothing is rendered because nothing was established.
human_map.UNEARNED: The investigation recorded an architecture, but the system could not produce a visual model that faithfully represents it — so no model is shown.

GEOMETRY_UNAVAILABLE_vs_UNKNOWN.rule: conflating these was the R451-C2 identified defect; the separation is load-bearing

presentation_states_terminal_map.note: lib/presentationState.ts::resolvePresentationState — the ONE mapping for the model/workspace surface
presentation_states_terminal_map.INVESTIGATING: run active — the conversation is the surface
presentation_states_terminal_map.INFRASTRUCTURE_PAUSED: transport-terminal (RUN_BLOCKED_*/INTERRUPTED/FAILED_*) — status is the singular authority; a stale scientific-looking user_state_view NEVER promotes it
presentation_states_terminal_map.TECHNOLOGY_NOT_ESTABLISHED: terminal, no invention, no geometry — honest scientific absence
presentation_states_terminal_map.GEOMETRY_UNAVAILABLE: invention exists, geometry absent (not applicable / generation failed) with the recorded reason
presentation_states_terminal_map.GEOMETRY_READY_RENDER_BLOCKED: canonical GLB exists and stays interactive; the typed cause (renderer_unavailable | gate_not_passed | not_attempted | infrastructure | rendering_in_progress | visual_input_missing | release_unverified | geometry_unverified | legacy_render_unverified | visual_authority_not_engineering) picks the EXACT sentence
presentation_states_terminal_map.VISUAL_READY: geometry_state == visual_complete AND engineering_authority == ENGINEERING — the absolute invariant; a contradiction pair fails closed to GEOMETRY_READY_RENDER_BLOCKED[visual_authority_not_engineering]
presentation_states_terminal_map.LEGACY_STATE_UNAVAILABLE: pre-typed projection — displays ONLY this compatibility state, never a current-looking state
presentation_states_terminal_map.PRESENTATION_STATE_UNAVAILABLE: an unrecognized backend geometry/visual state — fail-closed unknown, no scientific claim from a parse failure

error_semantics_vocabulary.invariant: BLOCKED / FAILED / UNKNOWN / NOT_RUN / REJECTED / PENDING stay distinct in every rendering

conversational_translations.BLOCKED: The technical work hit an infrastructure wall. The test could not be completed — nothing has been rejected because of it.
conversational_translations.FAILED (infrastructure): A technical step could not complete — that is infrastructure, not a verdict about the idea.
conversational_translations.FAILED (scientific): A step of the investigation recorded a scientific failure — kept as a finding, stated in the record.
conversational_translations.UNKNOWN: The recorded state carries no verdict — unknown stays unknown.
conversational_translations.NOT_RUN: The adversarial test has not been completed. Nothing is claimed either way.
conversational_translations.REJECTED: The adversarial tests contradicted this candidate. Recorded cause: <cause>.
conversational_translations.PENDING: In progress — the search is running now.
